notes.title: 11.21 Update
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
 Fixed an issue where the boss in Round 40 could not be attacked.
 We apologize for not being able to address an issue that significantly impacted gameplay in a timely manner.
 As compensation, we have awarded all users 10,000 CP. We will continue to strive for better service in the future.



Quality of Life Improvements
 Fixed an issue where the drag box was not functioning.
 Added a camera zoom-in feature using the scroll wheel.
 Enabled screen switching using F1 to F5 keys.
 Added the ability to assign units using Ctrl + 1 to 0 keys.



Performance Adjustments
 Identified that buff characters (Emia, Fukiko) showed excessively high performance when their attack speed buffs were stacked.
 Adjusted attack speed buffs so they cannot exceed three times the buffing character's attack speed.

notes.title: Update Notes For Nov 2
notes.notes:
Fixed issues with the monsters in Round 23 and Round 30.
 Fixed an issue where client settings were changed during updates. (Settings may reset with this update)
